text:
emily: quick idea 1: lunch-bingo + 7-second brag at 12:30? tiny prizes (sticker, glory). who9s in?

devin: love it. bingo card idea: 'mystery Tupperware', 'spicy mayo incident', 'forgot headphones', 'plant rescue' :grin:

rao: count me in. i can do the 7-second brag 1: it's either my cat's new trick or i finally fixed that flaky monitor.

nina: i will bring a box of weird tea samples as a prize. can we make a rule: brag must be 7 seconds or less. no powerpoint.

chris: in. also proposing a silly tiebreaker: rock-paper-scissors lightning round.

ops-bot: Poll created: "Lunch Bingo + 7s Brag @12:30?" Options: Yes / Maybe / Nope. Expires in 2h.

emily: votes: Yes. also adding a micro-rule: winners get to pick the office playlist for 10 minutes.

devin: i will accept playlist tyranny in exchange for a sticker.

rao: `7-second brag` prep tip: practice counting to 7 out loud. timing is sacred.

nina: reminder: no live cooking demos. last time was scented smoke alarm chaos.

chris: bringing a tiny bell for announcing winners. also i will bring a single tomato from my garden as an objet d'art prize.

emily: beautiful. final checklist: bingo cards (i'll print), bell (chris), tea (nina), stickers (devin), snacks (rao). meeting point: kitchen table 12:25.

ops-bot: Reminder set: "Lunch Bingo & 7s Brag" at 12:30 (30m).

emily: See you at lunch. may the best 7-second brag win. :trophy:
